review_candidates.title: Data Visualization Designer (Communications Specialist)
review_candidates.description: About BOOST BOOST LLC is a dynamic management consulting firm that offers an array of government-compliant back-office solutions to support our teaming partners within the GovCon space. Our consultants are experts in the areas of Accounting, Contracts, Human Resources, Recruiting & Sourcing, and Strategic Pricing and our passion is to guide and propel our partners towards success within this competitive sector. BOOST is helping our client, StratasCorp Technologies , find a Data Visualization Designer (Communications Specialist) This role is on-site in Washington, D.C at the Navy Yard. There are no remote opportunities. Active secret clearance is required. Job Description: Build and maintain PowerPoint products for decision briefs, governance forums, program reviews, and headquarters engagements, working from rough content supplied by action officers and technical subject matter experts. Design charts, tables, timelines, organizational views, and process diagrams that make comparison, trend, dependency, and risk visible at a glance, selecting the chart form that fits the underlying data rather than defaulting to the template. Rebuild inherited slides that are technically accurate but visually unreadable, reducing text density, correcting hierarchy, and imposing a consistent visual grammar across a deck. Own slide masters, layouts, color and type systems, and reusable component libraries so that products remain consistent across many authors and multiple briefing cycles. Produce the graphic elements required for data presentation, including custom vector icons, callouts, annotation systems, and modular diagram components. Apply corporate and government template standards, required document markings, and accessibility requirements including sufficient color contrast and colorblind safe palettes. Maintain version control and source traceability so that every figure can be tied back to the data that produced it, and so that late changes to a number propagate correctly. Hold quality under compressed timelines. Tasking frequently arrives late, changes after it arrives, and is due before the next senior forum. Job Requirements: • Bachelor's degree in graphic design, information or communication design, data visualization, statistics, journalism, or a related field. Demonstrated equivalent skill will be accepted in lieu of a degree. • One to three years of relevant experience. Internship, academic, freelance, student publication, and personal project work all count toward this. Candidates at the entry level are encouraged to apply. • Advanced PowerPoint proficiency, including slide masters and layouts, alignment and distribution tools, merge shapes, the selection pane, and vector editing inside the application. Keyboard driven working habits are expected. • Demonstrated ability to build charts from raw data in Excel, including pivot tables and formatting well beyond default chart output. • Working command of visual design fundamentals: grid and alignment, typographic hierarchy, contrast, use of negative space, and restraint in color. • Ability to take disorganized source material and return a coherent visual argument with limited supervision and limited subject matter hand holding. • Precise written English and a high tolerance for detail work at the headquarters level. • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Advana, including publishing figures intended for a briefing rather than for a dashboard. • Adobe Illustrator and InDesign, used for figure production and document layout. • Familiarity with Navy or DOD briefing conventions, including standard decision brief structure and classification and CUI marking requirements. • Ability to produce simple explanatory graphics for technical subject matter such as network architecture, identity services, or cloud hosting. • Basic scripting or automation experience, for example Python or VBA, applied to repetitive chart or deck production. A portfolio is mandatory. Applications submitted without one will not be reviewed. Candidates should submit a PDF or a link to an online portfolio containing, at minimum, the following. • Three or more figures or slides in which the candidate began with raw or messy data and produced the final visual, each accompanied by one or two sentences explaining why that chart form was chosen over the alternatives. • At least one before and after pair showing a dense or poorly structured slide rebuilt for clarity, with the original included. • At least one multi slide sequence demonstrating consistency of layout, type, and color across a set rather than a single polished one off. • Willingness to provide native source files or to walk the panel through construction of a selected item, so that the panel can confirm the candidate built the artifact rather than restyled a purchased template. The anticipated salary range for this role is $125,000 to $145,000 annually. The anticipated salary range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. The final starting salary will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including the selected candidate's qualifications, skills, relevant experience, education, certifications, and work location (where applicable), as well as internal equity and market considerations. We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and being the person customers count on to get their instruments back up and running? Are you energized by hands-on troubleshooting, problem solving, and working with advanced scientific instrumentation? Would you enjoy a role that combines engineering expertise, customer interaction, and travel while supporting customers across a wide range of industries and applications? If you said yes, please apply to join Anton Paar QuantaTec as a Customer Service Engineer and put your technical skills to work installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing sophisticated scientific instruments while delivering the exceptional service and support our customers rely on. Job Description Job Summary Responsibilities The Customer Support Engineer is tasked with providing support to our sales subsidiaries and partner organizations concerning the operation and maintenance of Anton Paar QuantaTec analytical laboratory instruments. The responsibilities of the Customer Support Engineer include: Providing the highest quality technical support to our customers and addressing all service and support inquiries related to our products utilizing designated reports and systems. Conveying customer feedback and requirements to the departments responsible within the company to enhance product quality sustainably, as well as offering additional ideas for ongoing product development. Delivering prompt, high-quality, and cost-effective repairs to customers. Communicating quality-related information through the established reports and systems. Roles And Responsibilities The Customer Support Engineer is a self-starter with excellent communication skills who engages with Intercompany teams to provide solutions. Job duties include: Responsibly address all technical inquiries from both internal and external customers. Regularly monitor the status of support tickets within the product domain. Organize and deliver training sessions for service engineers, either internally or on-site. Collaborate with the Technical Documentation team to produce service manuals, maintenance protocols, and instructional videos. Assist subsidiaries and sales partners with installations, setup, or service and maintenance activities at customer locations. Prepare necessary documentation for activities related to the approval of serial production, such as generating spare parts lists. Update and maintain entries in the Product Knowledge Database. Manage the operational processing of repairs and returned goods, including reception, identification, organization, process oversight, billing, and closure. Maintain the calibration and functionality of analytical instruments used by Anton Paar QuantaTec within the Product Competence and Customer Support sectors. Be prepared to travel domestically or internationally to other Anton Paar facilities, not exceeding 25% of the time. Perform all other duties as assigned. Qualifications Education and Experience The Customer Support Engineer position generally necessitates a combination of experience, educational background, training, certifications, and pertinent skills. Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a related field Three years of experience in customer service or support Excellent communication skills Proven ability to collaborate effectively with team members, as well as with internal and external customers Demonstrated proficiency in efficient work methods and capacity to manage multiple tasks within a fast-paced environment Preferred Skills Include Possession of a Master’s Degree in Engineering or a related discipline. You will proactively identify and resolve hardware issues, manage RMA processes, and stay ahead of emerging hardware technologies to support SpaceXAI's data center operations. This role demands deep technical expertise in hardware diagnostics, and forward-looking hardware evaluation. RESPONSIBILITIES: Analyze firmware packages and hardware specifications for upcoming releases for compatibility, performance, and reliability in SpaceXAI's data center environment. Run security scanning and CVE / vulnerability analysis on firmware and related components. Flag safety issues (electrical, thermal, power-protection, fail-safe behavior) before the package hits the floor. Investigate and diagnose hardware failures, including "grey failures" (ambiguous or intermittent issues), proving them as true hardware defects through rigorous testing and data analysis. Manage vendor relationships, including initiating RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) claims, negotiating beyond standard processes when necessary, and holding vendors accountable for resolutions. Collaborate with Data Center Operations Technicians to troubleshoot, repair, and optimize hardware systems in real-time. Develop and implement monitoring tools, scripts, and processes to detect hardware anomalies early and minimize downtime. Document failure modes, RCAs, AFR / reliability models, RMA outcomes, and hardware evaluations into a team knowledge base. Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for hardware-related issues in the Memphis data center BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 2+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering, preferably in high-performance computing or data center environments. Proven expertise in firmware analysis, hardware specifications review, and release validation. Strong experience with RMA processes, including filing claims, vendor negotiations, and pushing for resolutions outside standard protocols. Demonstrated ability to diagnose and prove complex hardware failures, including grey or intermittent issues, using tools, logic analyzers, or diagnostic software. Familiarity with data center hardware components (e.g., servers, GPUs, networking equipment) and emerging technologies. Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) for automation and analysis, plus general experience in at least one systems language (C, C++, Java, Rust, or similar). Not required to be expert in all of them. Excellent problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to reliability engineering. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including operations technicians. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Experience in AI/ML infrastructure or supercomputing environments. Knowledge of vendor ecosystems (e.g., NVIDIA, Dell, HP, Supermicro) and supply chain management. Certifications in hardware engineering or reliability (e.g., CRE, CompTIA Server+). Prior work in a fast-paced startup or tech company like SpaceXAI. SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice .
